password.description: If omitted, a one-time password is generated and returned once.

value.description: For "set" a price; for "percent" a percentage such as 5 or -10; for "amount" a signed amount to add.

factorToBase.description: How many base units one of this unit contains, e.g. 10 for a strip of 10 tablets.

confirmDuplicate.description: Set to true to register a product even though a very similar one exists.

unitCost.description: Cost of ONE BASE UNIT (for example one tablet).

idempotencyKey.description: A new value for each sale attempt; reuse it when retrying the same sale.
